_owner: cc-opus-3 owns this file (LQ-20261107-332, WP1+WP2). Other work packages send their keys to the owner; the 'plan' block is WP3's (cc-opus-2, LQ-20261107-333), accepted verbatim. Spec: persistent-state/handoffs/SPEC_MARKET_EVENT_REENTRY_20261107.md. Advisory only: nothing here sizes, orders or touches a broker.
_units: Percentages are percent (5.0 = 5%). A drawdown threshold is a positive magnitude; the code compares it against the negative move.

data._why: Finviz-only rule (spec 2): closes and last prices come from market_quotes rows written by the allowed sources; yfinance rows are never read. market_ohlcv_bars daily is yfinance-only (measured 2026-11-07), so it is not a source here.

split_guard._why: SOXX 2026-11-05: prev_close 451.20 against price 144.66 is a 3:1 split the provider did not adjust. A ratio this close to a split ratio is a data break, not a drawdown.

affected_groups._why: A broad selloff names the groups that took the hit: MRE group state in these states, or a 5-day move relative to SPY at or below -rel_move_pct.

seed_episodes.reason: Operator 2026-11-07 (spec 0): Thu 11-05 to Fri 11-06 selloff, QQQ -5.1%, MRE tier RED. Baseline is the 2026-11-04 close.

group_map._why: MRE sector group key -> Finviz sector/industry filter on ticker_snapshot_daily.data. Most specific first: a symbol joins the first group that matches.

sector_peers._why: Peers come from the Finviz snapshot already in ticker_snapshot_daily (no live screen call; the Finviz filter tokens proposed by cc-haiku-1 are unvalidated, and an ignored token returns the whole universe). Quality floors applied after the read.
sector_peers._avg_vol_units: ticker_snapshot_daily.data.avg_vol_m is thousands of shares (NVDA 114187.68 on 2026-11-03), despite the key name.

quality_factors._why: Each factor maps linearly from its 'bad' anchor (0) to its 'good' anchor (1), clamped. A factor with no data drops out and the remaining weights renormalise: absent is not negative (spec 4.2). coverage = present weight / total weight.

orders_backlog._why: Input is the YoY growth % of remaining performance obligations (sec_xbrl, primary source; cc-deepseek-8 note 2026-11-07T2216Z). A symbol with no RPO tag, no YoY match or a stale filing gets null and the factor drops out (never 0). Catalyst/transcript backlog text is display-only until an extraction is validated.

discount._why: excess = drawdown - beta x benchmark drawdown. Falling more than beta implies is discount; the score reaches 100 at full_scale_pct of excess.

fell_for_reason._unexplained_why: No earnings calendar in the DB (measured 2026-11-07): a name that fell this much more than beta implies, with no catalyst row, is flagged reason_evidence.unexplained_excess_drop for the operator; it is NOT marked fell_for_reason without evidence.
